description: Shows one social publishing automation in full: state, how it picks posts, channels, schedule and filters. Use when the user asks how an automation is set up or when it runs next. Not for its run history (use list_social_automation_events). Returns the automation's settings.

automation_id.description: ID of the publishing automation. Get it from list_social_automations.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_social_automation
title: Get publishing automation
